page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.large is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.s2 server family. It is configured with 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores with 1.0 thread per core, running on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is equipped with 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include any local storage or bundled GPU hardware.

A key technical limitation of this instance is the absence of advanced CPU instruction sets. The hardware profile lacks support for Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), and cryptographic acceleration flags such as AES or SHA_NI. Additionally, the instance does not feature local NVMe SSD storage, requiring reliance on network-attached storage for all data persistence.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.s2.large offers a low-density, dedicated resource profile suitable for basic utility workloads that do not require high memory capacity or specialized vector processing. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent performance compared to shared-core alternatives, making it appropriate for lightweight web serving, basic proxy services, small-scale application hosting, and simple background tasks.
